title: Wimpy
body:
Syntax: wimpy <0-100>

Description: Sets an auto-flee threshold as a percentage of your max health -- once your health drops to or below it during a fight (PvE or PvP), you automatically attempt 'flee' on your own behalf. 0 disables it, the default. With no argument, shows your current setting instead of changing it.

Date: 2026-08-17
